messages:
elaine_sales: quick heads-up: Nimbus POC flaky. They use function-calls + JSON mode to push catalog rows. Sometimes the stream ends with stray bytes after the JSON and their client parser errors. Also saw a couple 429s while they ramped. Need eng + security + pricing triage.

pat_eng: can you paste a redacted stream chunk + headers and model variant?

elaine_sales: pasted from their debug logs (redacted):

```
{"tool":"catalog_ingest","rows":[{"sku":"N-1","name":"Flux"}]}}
\x00\x07

parse error at offset 198
```

headers: `x-rw-model: redwood-tool-1.0-q6`, `x-client-id: nimbus-42`, endpoint: `/v1/stream`, parallel workers: 12.

anshul_ml: q6 fast path can emit a tiny binary footer when streaming flushes race with batching; we've seen non-UTF8 trailing bytes. Two tracks: (1) sanitizer in stream assembler to trim non-utf8 tail and assert final char is `}` or `]`; (2) optional fallback wrapper so clients still get valid JSON (e.g. `\{"_rw_tool_malformed\":true,\"raw_b64\":\"...\"}`).

ram_oncall: 429s look like client-side burst. I can temporarily bump per-client burst tokens for repro and add them to canary routing.

mina_security: SQ asks: can keys live in customer HSM, and can logs be kept in eu-west-1 for 5 years? Private supports customer-managed KMS/HSM; Hosted Dedicated can be provisioned in eu-west-1 with KMS addendum. Long retention should be handled via export/archive or extended retention add-on. I'll draft formal language for the questionnaire.

carl_salesops: ballpark Dedicated for this workload (35-50k tokens/day with spikes) is ~Wk/mo, reserved min 4 GPUs. I'll loop finance for an official quote.

pat_eng: plan: implement sanitizer + opt-in base64 fallback behind a route flag `tool_stream_fallback=base64`. Also emit streaming-metric tag when sanitizer runs. I'll open a small PR.

ci-bot: [ci 2401.2] stream-assembler-sanitize branch built. unit tests: \u2705 integration: \u2705. staging deploy queued.

pat_eng: canary plan: add `nimbus-42` to canary and temporarily increase burst to 200 for 4 hours. ram, can you handle routing?

ram_oncall: added nimbus-42 to canary routing and bumped burst tokens to 200 for repro window. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/integrations/nimbus-42/streams (alerts set).

elaine_sales: customer will repro tonight 20:00 UTC. they need stable POC by EOW. if canary shows clean JSON + no 429s they will sign. please report results here. :pray:
